src.bungie:
Cast your rift to create a Void Soul. When you damage a target with a weapon, your Void Soul flies to them and drains them, doing damage and weakening them. Combatants affected by the Soul are also briefly suppressed.

When a target is being drained, you are granted grenade and melee energy (if running Healing Rift) or health (if running Empowering Rift).

Defeating a target who is being drained by your Void Soul grants class ability energy.

The Void Soul's damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
src.clarity:
Casting your Rift grants a 'Void Soul' for 25 seconds.
Weapon Hits send the Void Soul towards the target's location, projecting a 10 meter radius Weakening field upon arrival that lasts for 9.25 seconds. Void Soul continously deals damage and applies Weaken every 0.7 seconds. The Weaken lasts for 4 [2.5] seconds after its last application. For the first 4 [?] seconds of being tethered, targets are Suppressed as well.
If you have Healing Rift equipped, the Void Soul grants 4% Grenade and Melee Energy every other tick. If you have Empowering Rift equipped, the Void Soul grants 25 HP every other tick.
Defeating targets within Void Soul's radius grant Class Ability Energy based on Combatant Tier:
• Tier 1: 10%
• Tier 2: 15%
• Tier 3: 20%
• Tier 4 or 5: 50%
• Players: 33.3%
Void Soul counts as a Grenade Ability and is buffed by, and triggers, grenade-specific effects.

Grants Void Soul Ready for 25 seconds. Can stack up to 2 Void Souls.

Combatants within the Draining Field are additionally suppressed.

Healing Rift: Grants 4% Grenade and Melee Energy every 1.4 seconds.
Empowering Rift: Restores 25 HP every 1.4 seconds.

Tier 1 Combatant = 10% | T2 = 15% | T3 = 20% | T4+ = 50% | Guardian = 33.4%
